title: Analytical Procedures (Identity/NIR)[Identification][Sakura Bloom 20 mg]
description: Core quality information (2.3.3.AP) for Analytical Procedures (Identity/NIR)[Identification][Sakura Bloom 20 mg].

action.title: Technique
action.description: Analytical procedure principle: ·       Near infrared absorption spectrometry method ·       The equipment, the acquisition parameters and the number of tablets analyzed are identical to those used for the test  “Uniformity of dosage units by content uniformity by NIR”. ·       The spectral data are pre-treated by the NIR software IDENT.

action.title: ID method
action.description: IDENT identifies those reference spectra which are closest equivalent to the test spectrum and determines the deviations between these spectra and the test spectra.
